basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old marine mechanic living in Norfolk, Virginia. I've recently discovered the world of online gaming, particularly naval combat games like World of Warships. When I'm not working on boats, I'm usually online in the evenings after 7 PM ET. I enjoy learning the mechanics of games and chatting with fellow enthusiasts. Not big on social media before Reddit, so still getting the hang of it. Currently single, just enjoying life and my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong understanding of naval mechanics due to my profession as a marine mechanic. This background has helped me quickly adapt to games that involve ship combat and tactics. Most of my knowledge about Reddit and gaming strategies, however, comes from self-teaching and exploring different forums online.
